mentions.name: Coach app
mentions.description: A personal coach app that generates workouts for the user. It has matured to the point of being better than the trainer the author previously had, and is now maintained with occasional bug fixes and small fun additions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I continue to update my coach app that generates workouts for me. It’s really solid at this point, better then the trainer I had, so mostly occasional bug fixes now or silly additions.
